source_note: PLACEHOLDER Leitner/spaced-repetition rules. Every number is invented to make the flashcard engine runnable and MUST be checked against pedagogy/product intent before it is trusted (see docs/TO_VERIFY.md).
max_box_why: PLACEHOLDER: a card graduates after five successful boxes; more boxes add little once recall is stable.

box_intervals_days.why: PLACEHOLDER: due dates per box (roughly doubling), so a card you keep getting right is seen less and less often.

box_intervals_days_why: PLACEHOLDER: box 1 is tomorrow, then 3/7/16/35 days; spaced practice with growing gaps.

rating_box_delta.why: PLACEHOLDER: AGAIN resets to box 1 (delta sentinel), HARD holds the box, GOOD advances one, EASY advances two.

rating_box_delta_why: PLACEHOLDER: how each self-rated recall moves the box; AGAIN is a reset, not a decrement.

rating_score.why: PLACEHOLDER: map a recall rating onto the 0..1 evidence score that feeds topic mastery.

rating_score_why: PLACEHOLDER: evidence score per rating; 0.0/0.3/0.7/1.0 keeps a failed card from adding mastery.

overdue_interval_days.why: PLACEHOLDER: reviews of overdue cards still schedule from now using the new box interval, never from the old due date.

new_cards_per_day_why: PLACEHOLDER: cap on brand-new cards surfaced per local day so a large deck cannot flood a session.
lapse_score_penalty_why: PLACEHOLDER: extra multiplier applied to the evidence score when a card lapses (rating AGAIN); 0 means use the AGAIN score as-is.
